setup_commands: pip install duckdb pandas openpyxl rapidfuzz pyarrow
echo '✅ Environment ready for Estelita pipeline'
validation_steps: python -c "import duckdb, pandas; print('DuckDB + pandas ready')"

safety_guidelines.locking: Ensure no two DuckDB sessions open simultaneously on primary_archive.duckdb
safety_guidelines.backups: Always run maintenance.sh to snapshot backups before large merges
safety_guidelines.file_convention: Use YYYY_MM_DD naming for every generated dataset or report
